returnPolicies.description: You have 15 days from the date of delivery to request a return. Once this window closes, the transaction is considered final and refunds can no longer be processed.
You may request a return if the item meets one of the following conditions:
items: Damaged or Defective: The item arrived broken or is not functioning.
Not as Described: The item significantly differs from the listing details or photos.
Wrong Item Received: You received a completely different product.

returnPolicies.description: Return shipping costs depend on the reason for the return:
items: Seller Error (Damaged/Not as Described): The seller covers the return shipping costs.
Buyer Preference: The buyer must pay for the return shipping label.
Original Shipping: Initial shipping fees are non-refundable unless the return is due to a seller error.

returnPolicies.description: To successfully receive your refund, the returned item must meet these criteria:
items: The item must be in the exact condition it was received.
All original packaging, accessories, and documentation must be included.
No signs of additional wear, use, or damage.
Hygiene seals (if applicable) must remain completely intact.
